//: Redirects to canonicalise every URL to https://infocomiva.live. Both the .vercel.app production URL AND the www subdomain 301-bounce to the apex domain, so Google indexes one canonical site and visitors who hit the wrong URL land on the right one. The deployment-specific preview URLs (infocomiva-website-git-*.vercel.app) intentionally do NOT redirect — those stay reachable for staging / PR review.
